checks_run.actual: branding.test.ts:4 `import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"` gives fileViolations [] (1/1 passed). The fs-write-then-literal-same-module-import plant gives 0 violations, matching the stated residual (b).

checks_run.procedure: Assess the D-053 residual framing: sweep the Node 22.22.2 builtinModules list and process.* for loader/exec capabilities not in LOADER_BUILTINS or PROCESS_LOADERS, plant them through the lint, and prove them at runtime
checks_run.command: node -e 'require("module").builtinModules'; plant-r7.test.ts adjacent probes; node runner.mjs (node:test run isolation:none); node -e 'process.execve(...)'
checks_run.environment: disposable clone $TMPDIR/rev @2cfbf4f; scratch dir $TMPDIR/probe; Node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Every demonstrable loader route is either flagged or covered by a stated residual (a)/(b)/(c)
checks_run.actual: Residuals (a) and (b) are accurate. process.dlopen and node:sqlite are closed, and wasi/WebAssembly is named in (c). Two existing, non-future routes give 0 lint violations, and both work at runtime. node:test run({files:[computed], isolation:'none'}) imports a file in-process from a computed path (same pid), with no code generation. Global process.execve runs /bin/sh. Neither is named by any residual, and (c) describes future or unknown capabilities. Raised as Low, non-mandatory F-DG1-128 under D-053's reopen criterion.

summary: PASS. F-DG1-127 is verified closed. node:sqlite and sqlite are banned in every import form, architecture.test.ts passes 78/78 including A1, and the real module tree has 0 violations. node:fs stays allowed as stated residual (b). Residuals (a) and (b) are honest. Residual (c) does not cover two loader/exec routes that exist today and that I demonstrated at runtime: node:test run({isolation:'none'}) from a computed path, and process.execve. They are raised as new Low, non-mandatory F-DG1-128, which does not block. Every required check was re-run and passed: typecheck, build, lint, openapi, no-cdn, format, unit 271/271, integration 200/200 twice on disposable PG16, gates/agents 105/105, deploy 59/59, SBOM, DG0 historical, ci.yml identity. Installer AC-1..AC-10: the offline cases pass 13/13. AC-1 (effect) and the real-repo install are BLOCKED because the sandbox has no registry. All 8 requirements are complete, with their evidence present. No unresolved Critical, High or mandatory finding.
